key_points: Donald Trump, the 45th president, grew up in Queens, New York, earned an economics degree, and built a real estate and entertainment career before entering politics.
Trump was unusual among presidents for having no prior government or military experience, unlike earlier presidents without government experience, who had all been generals.
During his 2016 campaign, Trump relied on free media exposure like television, radio, and social media rather than paid advertising, and defeated 16 Republican rivals before beating Hillary Clinton.
As president, Trump was known for communicating directly with the public through Twitter (now X), continuing a long history of presidents adapting to new communication technology.
main_idea: The passage describes Donald Trump's unusual path to the presidency, noting his lack of prior government or military experience and his direct, technology-driven style of public communication.
restate_sentence: And it will note a few ways that Trump’s background is unusual compared to most U.S. presidents.
